title: Website Contact & Company Enricher
description: Enrich domains with public business contact details.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains or website URLs (an email address also works: its domain is used). One per line; comma/semicolon lists are split.

maxPagesPerDomain.title: Max pages per domain
maxPagesPerDomain.description: Homepage plus the best contact/about/imprint pages found on it.

emailScope.title: Which emails to return
emailScope.description: role = generic mailboxes only (info@, sales@, support@…), the GDPR-friendly default; business = also named addresses on the company's own domain; all = every address published on the pages.

validateEmails.title: Validate emails (MX, disposable, typo)
validateEmails.description: DNS-over-HTTPS MX lookup plus disposable and typo checks (same logic as Fairquery Email Validator). No SMTP probing.

checkSpfDmarc.title: Report SPF / DMARC
checkSpfDmarc.description: Adds SPF/DMARC presence and DMARC policy for the company's mail domain.

defaultPhoneCountry.title: Default phone country
defaultPhoneCountry.description: ISO code (e.g. US, DE). When set, national-format numbers in page text are parsed too; otherwise only tel: links, JSON-LD and +international numbers are used.

domainConcurrency.title: Domains in parallel
domainConcurrency.description: Different sites crawled at once. Pages of one site are always fetched one at a time.

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between requests to one site (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Politeness delay per site; a larger robots.txt Crawl-delay wins (capped at 10 s).
